name: Long Tong
summary: The Tay crop rite on the lake shore, on the 10th of the first lunar month. The 2024 opening was the morning of 19 February at Nam Mau. The 2026 opening was 26 February at Bo Lu, xa Ba Be, Thai Nguyen. The next civil date moves, so check on arrival. No ticket was on the festival pages.
when: 10th of the first lunar month. 2024 opening 19 February. 2026 opening 26 February at Bo Lu. Later years: check on arrival.
